title: Lifting a subset from an index set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a subset of the $n$ indices, and let $T$ be a subset of $J$. Its lift to the full index set is the subset of the $n$ indices consisting of the underlying indices of the elements of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a subset of the $n$ indices
